headline: Record sales and subsidy-boosted profit, loss per share
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 9.64T (+59% y/y, +27.6% q/q) and operating profit KRW 756B (+25.7% y/y); EPS was a loss of KRW 2,058.
summary_long: Reports of the company's results put revenue at KRW 9.64T and operating profit at KRW 756B (margin 7.8%). That includes KRW 416.9B of US production credits; without them operating profit was KRW 339.1B (3.7% margin). EPS was a loss of KRW 2,058, versus a loss of KRW 1,613 in Q2 and a profit of KRW 1,056 a year ago.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures are preliminary and unaudited, from wire reposts of the company release and Korean press. One summary mentions a net loss near KRW 296.9B that could not be confirmed. EPS is Yahoo data.
